name: The Lobber
description: Adds the Lobber: a mischievous, enderman-like stalker that arrives on the first night as a shy little goblin and matures over days into an obsessive, malicious tormentor - knocking on doors, shattering windows, staring through them as you sleep, burning your base, and hurling blocks at anyone who dares look its way. Includes underground lore shrines.
